description: Biochemistry + metabolism decomposed. Enzyme kinetics (Michaelis-Menten), allosteric regulation, glycolysis, TCA cycle, electron transport chain, oxidative phosphorylation, photosynthesis, protein structure (Anfinsen, AlphaFold), DNA replication + transcription + translation.

sub_mechanisms.name: Michaelis_Menten_kinetics
sub_mechanisms.definition: v = V_max·[S] / (K_M + [S]). Rate vs substrate concentration.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of enzyme kinetics. K_M = substrate affinity. V_max = max rate. Standard analysis.

sub_mechanisms.name: competitive_inhibition
sub_mechanisms.definition: Inhibitor binds active site, competes with substrate. K_M apparent increases; V_max unchanged.
sub_mechanisms.why: Many drugs work this way. Statins compete for HMG-CoA reductase. Standard enzyme inhibition.

sub_mechanisms.name: allosteric_regulation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Enzyme has regulatory site distinct from active. Cooperative binding, sigmoidal kinetics.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hemoglobin, phosphofructokinase. Feedback control of metabolism. Foundation of regulation.

sub_mechanisms.name: glycolysis_pathway
sub_mechanisms.definition: Glucose → 2 pyruvate. 10 enzymatic steps. Net: 2 ATP + 2 NADH.
sub_mechanisms.why: Universal sugar catabolism. Cytoplasm. Anaerobic conditions: end product changes (lactate fermentation).

sub_mechanisms.name: TCA_Krebs_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Pyruvate → acetyl-CoA → CO2. 8 enzymes. Net per acetyl-CoA: 3 NADH + 1 FADH2 + 1 GTP.
sub_mechanisms.why: Central metabolism. Connects carb + fat + protein catabolism. Mitochondrial matrix.

sub_mechanisms.name: electron_transport_chain
sub_mechanisms.definition: NADH/FADH2 electrons → O2. Complexes I-IV in inner mitochondrial membrane.
sub_mechanisms.why: Generates proton gradient across membrane. Foundation of ATP synthesis. Mitochondrial.

sub_mechanisms.name: ATP_synthase
sub_mechanisms.definition: F0F1 ATP synthase. Proton gradient drives ATP synthesis via rotational catalysis.
sub_mechanisms.why: ~32-34 ATP per glucose total. Nobel 1997 (Walker, Boyer). Foundation of bioenergetics.

sub_mechanisms.name: photosynthesis_light_reactions
sub_mechanisms.definition: Chlorophyll absorbs light. PSII + PSI split water; reduce NADP+ to NADPH; pump H+.
sub_mechanisms.why: Energy capture from sunlight. ATP + NADPH for Calvin cycle. Foundation of life on Earth.

sub_mechanisms.name: Calvin_cycle
sub_mechanisms.definition: Dark reactions. CO2 fixed by Rubisco; reduced to sugar. Requires ATP + NADPH.
sub_mechanisms.why: Carbon fixation. Rubisco most abundant protein on Earth. Slow + inefficient — limits crops.

sub_mechanisms.name: DNA_replication
sub_mechanisms.definition: Semi-conservative. Helicase + polymerase + ligase. Leading + lagging strand.
sub_mechanisms.why: Faithful copy of genome. DNA polymerase proofreads (3'→5' exonuclease). Errors → mutations.

sub_mechanisms.name: transcription_translation
sub_mechanisms.definition: DNA → mRNA (transcription, RNA pol). mRNA → protein (translation, ribosome + tRNA).
sub_mechanisms.why: Central dogma. Genetic code: 64 codons → 20 amino acids (redundant). Foundation of molecular biology.

sub_mechanisms.name: protein_folding_Anfinsen
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sequence determines structure. Native state minimum free energy.
sub_mechanisms.why: Anfinsen's principle. AlphaFold validates computationally. Foundation of structural biology. Drug design.

derivation_rules.name: MM_kinetics_assume_steady_state
derivation_rules.why: Briggs-Haldane derivation. Foundation of enzyme kinetics. Most enzymes follow MM. Pre-equilibrium assumption alternative.

derivation_rules.name: ATP_yield_per_glucose
derivation_rules.why: Glycolysis: 2 ATP + 2 NADH. TCA: 6 NADH + 2 FADH2 + 2 ATP (per glucose). ETC + ATP synthase: ~2.5 ATP/NADH, 1.5 ATP/FADH2. Standard.

derivation_rules.name: chemiosmotic_gradient_drives_ATP
derivation_rules.why: Mitchell's chemiosmotic theory. Protons flow through F0; rotates F1; ATP synthesis. Universal mechanism. Nobel 1978.

derivation_rules.name: AlphaFold_solved_protein_folding
then: AlphaFold predicts 3D structure with high accuracy
derivation_rules.why: DeepMind 2020-2021. 50-year challenge largely solved. Biology research transformed. Validates Anfinsen. Nobel 2024.

derivation_rules.name: allosteric_enables_metabolic_regulation
derivation_rules.why: End product binds allosteric site, slows pathway. PFK in glycolysis inhibited by ATP. Standard metabolic control.
